description: 配方 → 主视觉图像提示词。每条都按「单一主体 + 材质 + 光 + 镜头 + 负空间」写，禁止抽象元素堆砌。
globalNegative: vector clipart, wireframe, thin hairlines, blueprint, flat UI icons, infographic placeholder, empty rectangles, dashed circles, graph grid, flow chart, network diagram, stick figures, clip art, cheap 3d render, plastic look, oversaturated, muddy colors, low contrast, text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, collage of icons

defaults.quality: editorial book cover artwork, single dominant subject, strong material presence, cinematic depth, fine grain, high detail
defaults.no: no text, no typography, no logo, no border, no frame
defaults.negativeExtra: multiple focal points, busy background, cluttered composition, symmetrical centered layout

R01.subject: a single oversized matte crimson sphere resting against a precision-brushed steel plate, one thin black anodized rod crossing behind it
R01.light: one large softbox from the upper left, hard-edged shadow falling to the right, cool white balance
R01.lens: 85mm, eye level, moderate depth of field
R01.composition: subject occupies the right third, left two thirds empty warm paper, one horizontal seam line at the lower third
R01.materials: matte lacquer, brushed steel, thick cotton paper
R01.palette: warm off-white, ink black, vermilion red

R02.subject: a solitary architectural concrete stair turning out of frame, cropped so only the handrail and one shadow are legible
R02.light: low afternoon sun raking across the surface, warm dust in the air
R02.composition: diagonal crop, subject pushed to the upper right, large quiet shadow area at the bottom left for type

R03.subject: one large white ceramic torus standing upright on a pale plaster surface, a single faint shadow anchoring it
R03.light: diffused north light, almost shadowless, slight falloff at the edges
R03.composition: object centered slightly above middle, 55 percent empty pale space below
R03.materials: unglazed porcelain, fine plaster, cotton paper
R03.palette: chalk white, pale grey, one warm shadow

R04.subject: a thick slab of blackened steel leaning at a brutal angle, one raw edge catching light, casting a hard black shadow
R04.light: single hard strobe from the side, deep blacks, clipped highlight
R04.composition: mass fills the lower two thirds, generous black void above for oversized type
R04.materials: blackened steel, coarse paper, screen-print ink
R04.palette: coal black, bone white, safety red

R05.subject: a loose arrangement of twelve material samples, stone, brass, paper and glass, laid on a grid-marked worktable
R05.light: even overhead light, soft contact shadows
R05.composition: modular clusters with deliberate gaps, wide margins on all sides
R05.materials: travertine, brass, recycled paper, smoked glass

R06.medium: natural light photograph on washi paper
R06.subject: a single bare branch with three leaves, its shadow falling across handmade paper
R06.light: soft window light through rice paper, gentle diffusion
R06.composition: branch enters from the upper right, lower left kept empty and quiet
R06.materials: washi paper, dry wood, ink wash
R06.palette: rice white, pale grey-green, faded indigo

R07.subject: one cracked ceramic vessel with a raw clay foot, a dry twig resting against it
R07.light: single soft window light, long slow shadow, dust visible
R07.composition: vessel lower left, vast empty textured wall above
R07.materials: unglazed clay, straw ash glaze, aged plaster
R07.palette: earth beige, ash grey, burnt umber

R08.subject: a single wooden chair floating above a calm sea, its shadow falling on the water below
R08.light: overcast sky, silver light, no visible sun
R08.composition: chair small in the upper half, infinite water in the lower half, immense negative space
R08.palette: slate blue, bone white, dim amber

R09.subject: a single figure-less empty boat drifting on a misted lake at dusk
R09.light: backlit dusk, warm horizon glow, cool blue shadows
R09.composition: boat in the lower third, sky and mist filling the upper frame
R09.materials: oil on canvas, visible brushwork, varnish
R09.palette: dusk rose, deep teal, dim gold

R10.subject: a single red brick balanced on a white marble pedestal in an empty gallery
R10.light: gallery track light, precise pool of light, dark falloff
R10.composition: pedestal dead center, enormous empty gallery walls
R10.palette: gallery white, brick red, shadow grey

R11.medium: minimal art photograph with watercolor wash
R11.subject: a single thin dry reed bent by wind, one pale wash of pigment behind it
R11.composition: reed crosses the frame diagonally, 70 percent empty wash
R11.materials: watercolor paper, pigment bloom, dry reed
R11.palette: paper white, pale indigo, faded sienna

R12.subject: one sweeping curve of a limestone facade meeting a sliver of sky
R12.light: early morning side light, long clean shadows
R12.composition: curve anchors the lower right, open sky upper left for type

R13.subject: a single rising ridge built from stacked brass plates, photographed like a mountain range
R13.light: hard raking light from the right, deep metallic shadows
R13.composition: ridge rising left to right, large dark sky above for figures

R14.subject: one translucent glass monolith with an internal network of fine light filaments, standing on a dark mirror
R14.light: cold rim light, caustics through glass, cyan and white
R14.composition: monolith right of center, dark reflective floor, wide empty upper left

R15.subject: one dense braided cord of glowing filaments splitting into three thinner strands against darkness
R15.composition: braid enters left edge and exits lower right, 60 percent darkness
R15.materials: optical fiber, smoke, matte black surface

R16.subject: one massive concrete stair hall receding into a single point of light
R16.composition: hard symmetry, vanishing point slightly below center
R16.palette: concrete grey, deep black, one white light

R17.subject: one red diagonal beam cutting across a black circle and a cream field, physical paper assembly
R17.light: flat even light, visible paper fibers
R17.composition: aggressive diagonal from lower left to upper right, off-center circle

R18.subject: one torn architectural photograph split into three offset planes, edges misaligned
R18.composition: exploded stack, tension between fragments, one clean void reserved for type

R19.subject: one simple hand at rest, printed in overlapping fluorescent pink and blue with visible misregistration
R19.composition: subject lower left, half-tone field filling the rest
R19.materials: risograph ink, cheap paper, halftone dots

R20.medium: digital experimental render, chrome and glitch
R20.subject: one liquid chrome form frozen mid-collapse, reflecting a distorted grid
R20.composition: form floats center-right, chromatic aberration at edges
R20.materials: liquid chrome, holographic film, digital noise

R21.subject: one lone road worker silhouette under a single sodium lamp at night, fog rolling through
R21.light: single warm sodium lamp, cold blue ambience, heavy atmosphere
R21.composition: figure small in the lower right, enormous dark sky, letterboxed feel

R22.subject: one folded sheet of textured paper catching a single blade of light, its crease sharp as a knife
R22.light: very soft directional light, gradient falloff
R22.composition: crease runs corner to corner, one half in shadow
R22.palette: warm white, soft grey, deep shadow

R23.subject: one aged index card with a red stamp and a folded corner, lying on a worn desk
R23.light: warm desk lamp from the side, dust in the beam
R23.composition: card off-center, plenty of empty worn desk surface
R23.materials: aged paper, iron gall ink, rubber stamp

R24.subject: one dissected seed pod rendered in precise cross-section, with fine hatching and annotation marks
R24.light: flat illustration light, no cast shadow
R24.composition: specimen centered, wide margins, small scale marks
R24.materials: engraved line on aged paper, iron gall ink

R25.subject: one single dried poppy pod on a long stem, photographed against a warm plaster wall
R25.light: soft side light, delicate shadow, warm cast
R25.composition: stem enters from bottom right, pod in upper third, vast wall

R26.subject: one twisted ribbon of brushed aluminium folding through itself, standing on a matte black plinth
R26.light: two rim lights, deep falloff, precise specular edge
R26.composition: sculpture upper right, heavy negative space lower left
R26.materials: brushed aluminium, black stone, soft studio haze
